map.新交付楼盘开荒保洁，按面积与重污系数核算工期，决定需进场多少人、几天完成。: Initial deep cleaning for a newly delivered property: use the area and a heavy-soiling factor to work out the duration and how many people to bring in and how many days it will take.
map.日常轻污系数约 1.0，中度脏污取 1.3~1.5，开荒或重油污可取 1.8~2: The factor for ordinary light soiling is about 1.0, for moderate soiling 1.3-1.5, and for initial cleaning or heavy oil soiling 1.8-2.0, with the site survey as the final word.
map.清洁工时估算器，根据清洁面积与类型估算所需工时与人员配置，辅助保洁排班与报价。: Cleaning hours estimator that computes the required hours and staffing from the cleaning area and type, supporting cleaning rosters and quotations.
map.物业投标或包月报价时，先按面积与区域类型估算人时，再乘以单价得出报价，避免拍脑袋: When a property tenders or quotes a monthly price, first estimate the labour hours from the area and area type, then multiply by the unit rate to get the quote, so items are not missed on a whim.
map.重污系数一般取多少？: What heavy-soiling factor is normally used?
map.默认只含清洁作业人时，不含领取、补充垃圾袋与清洁剂以及设备充电等辅助时间，需另行: By default it includes only the cleaning labour hours, excluding auxiliary time such as collecting and refilling bin bags and cleaning agents or charging equipment, which must be added separately.
map.：区域类型选办公室、脏污等级选轻污，按基准人时率约 0.02 人时/㎡ 估算约: : with area type set to office and soiling to light, the base labour rate of about 0.2 person-hours per m2 gives about 20 person-hours; with two shifts that means about 2 to 3 people for one working day.
